prereq: Stage 1–4 的任务、审批、验证、主动性和跨设备入口已经稳定。
已确定允许记忆的事实、偏好、经验和敏感信息边界。
每次技能变化都必须有对照评估、版本、权限交集和回滚路径。
contracts: 记忆来源
每条记忆记录来源、置信度、敏感度、时效、版本和召回原因。
遗忘传播
删除和遗忘必须产生 tombstone，并传播到索引、缓存和相关设备。
技能权限
候选技能只能继承或收窄现有权限，不能通过进化扩大授权。
评估可重复
评估集、基线、失败样本和运行配置可重复；优化不能只与旧版本比较。
晋升可回滚
Shadow、Canary、Promote、Rollback 都有记录，出现回归可以恢复到上一版本。
failures: 召回卡显示来源与原因，用户可以纠正或删除。
更新记忆、重建索引并记录纠正事件。
页面显示“遗忘未完成”并阻止继续依赖。
重试索引清理、设备同步和缓存失效，确认后再标记完成。
评估标记权限越界并直接拒绝晋升。
收窄 manifest 权限或重新设计技能，保持权限交集。
exclusions: 不允许无来源、无评估、无回滚的技能自动上线。
不允许记忆投毒改变权限、审批策略或系统事实。
不用“模型觉得有用”替代可重复评估。

prereq: Stage 1–4 tasks, approval, verification, proactivity, and cross-device entry are stable.
The boundary for remembered facts, preferences, experience, and sensitive data is explicit.
Every skill change has a control evaluation, version, permission intersection, and rollback path.
contracts: Memory provenance
Every memory records source, confidence, sensitivity, freshness, version, and recall reason.
Forgetting propagation
Deletion and forgetting create tombstones and propagate to indexes, caches, and relevant devices.
Skill permissions
A candidate skill can only inherit or narrow existing permissions; evolution cannot expand authority.
Repeatable evaluation
Evaluation sets, baselines, failure samples, and run configuration repeat; improvement is not compared only with an old build.
Rollbackable promotion
Shadow, Canary, Promote, and Rollback are recorded, and a regression can restore the previous version.
failures: The recall card shows source and reason; the user can correct or delete it.
Update memory, rebuild indexes, and record the correction event.
The page shows Forgetting incomplete and blocks reliance on it.
Retry index cleanup, device sync, and cache invalidation before marking complete.
Evaluation flags the overreach and rejects promotion.
Narrow the manifest or redesign the skill to preserve the permission intersection.
exclusions: Do not auto-launch a skill without provenance, evaluation, or rollback.
Do not let memory poisoning change permission, approval policy, or system facts.
Do not replace repeatable evaluation with model self-assessment.

zh.title: Memory Core 与记忆浏览器
zh.lead: 先让记忆可解释、可纠正，再让系统依靠它工作；用户必须知道记住了什么、来自哪里以及为什么被召回。
zh.outcome: 用户能看到 Hearth 记住了什么、来自哪里、为什么被召回，并能纠正或删除。
steps: 定义五类记忆模型，但先实现任务真正需要的 Episodic 与 Semantic 路径。
为记忆加入 provenance、置信度、敏感度、时效和预算。
实现写入路径、检索与 Context Pack 注入，记录每次召回原因。
建立记忆浏览器和“为什么召回”视图。
提供用户纠正、删除和标记敏感的能力。
验证错误记忆可纠正，敏感信息不进入不应出现的上下文。
zh.gate: 记忆有来源和敏感度；召回可解释；错误记忆可纠正；敏感信息不进入不应出现的上下文；记忆预算生效。
evidence: 记忆浏览器与召回解释

en.title: Memory Core and memory browser
en.lead: Make memory explainable and correctable before relying on it; users must know what was remembered, where it came from, and why it was recalled.
en.outcome: Users see what Hearth remembers, its source, why it was recalled, and can correct or delete it.
steps: Define the five memory classes but implement only the Episodic and Semantic paths tasks need first.
Add provenance, confidence, sensitivity, freshness, and budget to memory.
Implement write paths, retrieval, and Context Pack injection with recall reasons.
Build a memory browser and Why recalled view.
Provide correction, deletion, and sensitivity marking.
Verify wrong memories correct and sensitive data stays out of prohibited contexts.
en.gate: Memory has provenance and sensitivity; recall is explainable; wrong memory corrects; sensitive data stays out of prohibited contexts; memory budget applies.

zh.title: 记忆冲突、遗忘与导出
zh.lead: 记忆变旧、冲突或需要删除时，系统必须能更新、传播遗忘并允许用户完整导出。
zh.outcome: 过期事实会被更新或遗忘；用户可以导出全部记忆，也可以确认遗忘已经传播到所有相关索引和设备。
steps: 实现冲突检测、更新时间与显式覆盖规则。
实现删除/遗忘并行传播到索引、缓存和相关设备。
提供完整记忆导出，包含来源、版本、时间与敏感标记。
加入提示词注入与记忆投毒防护。
建立遗忘审计和敏感记忆隔离。
验证恶意内容不能通过记忆获得权限，用户能理解记忆为何变化。
zh.gate: 遗忘可传播且可验证；导出包含来源和版本；冲突不会静默覆盖正确事实；恶意内容不能通过记忆获得权限；用户能理解记忆为何变化。

en.title: Memory conflict, forgetting, and export
en.lead: When memory becomes stale, conflicting, or must be deleted, the system must update it, propagate forgetting, and allow complete export.
en.outcome: Stale facts update or are forgotten; users export all memory and confirm forgetting reached every relevant index and device.
steps: Implement conflict detection, update time, and explicit override rules.
Propagate deletion/forgetting to indexes, caches, and relevant devices in parallel.
Provide complete export with provenance, version, time, and sensitivity markers.
Add prompt-injection and memory-poisoning defenses.
Create forgetting audit and sensitive-memory isolation.
Verify malicious content cannot gain authority through memory and users understand why memory changed.
en.gate: Forgetting propagates and verifies; export includes source and version; conflict never silently overwrites correct facts; malicious content gains no authority; users understand changes.

zh.title: 轨迹、技能候选与评估集
zh.lead: 从可重放的真实轨迹中产生候选技能，但候选必须先经过对照评估、权限检查和无副作用的 Shadow 运行。
zh.outcome: 重复任务开始出现可复用的候选方法，用户能看到候选技能做了什么、需要什么权限、与现有方法相比是否更好。
steps: 实现轨迹采集与重放，保留工具调用、输入、结果和失败样本。
定义技能 manifest、权限声明、版本和评估元数据。
从成功与失败轨迹生成候选，不直接修改生产技能。
建立评估集、baseline 对比和评估污染防护。
运行 Shadow，禁止产生真实外部副作用。
展示候选差异、权限和收益，确认没有通过挑选样本伪造提升。
zh.gate: 评估可重复；候选技能不扩大权限；Shadow 不产生真实副作用；用户能看到候选差异；没有通过挑选样本伪造提升。

en.title: Trajectories, skill candidates, and evaluation sets
en.lead: Generate candidate skills from replayable real trajectories, but require control evaluation, permission checks, and side-effect-free Shadow runs first.
en.outcome: Repeated work begins to yield reusable candidate methods; users see what a candidate does, its permissions, and whether it beats the current method.
steps: Implement trajectory capture and replay with tool calls, inputs, results, and failure samples.
Define skill manifests, permission declarations, versions, and evaluation metadata.
Generate candidates from success and failure trajectories without touching production skills.
Create evaluation sets, baseline comparison, and contamination defenses.
Run Shadow mode with no real external side effects.
Show candidate differences, permissions, and gains; verify no cherry-picked evidence.
en.gate: Evaluation repeats; candidates do not expand permissions; Shadow creates no real side effect; users see differences; no cherry-picking fakes a gain.

zh.title: Evolution 晋升门与 Stage 5 发布
zh.lead: 只有经过评估、Canary 和小范围真实使用后，候选技能才能晋升；出现问题时必须能回滚并解释原因。
zh.outcome: 一个候选技能可以经过评估、Canary 和小范围真实使用后晋升；出现问题时能回滚，并说明回滚原因。
steps: 实现 Shadow → Canary → Promote → Rollback 状态机和权限交集。
为技能加入版本化、签名和运行时选择。
建立技能 UI，显示候选、权限、评估结果和当前选择。
至少完成一个完整晋升案例，并演练回滚。
记录回滚原因、影响范围和用户可见说明。
完成 Stage 5 安全与评估报告，确认没有权限扩大或安全回归。
zh.gate: Stage 5 退出条件全部满足；至少一个技能有对照评估、晋升和回滚记录；无安全回归；用户能理解系统为什么采用新方法。

en.title: Evolution promotion gate and Stage 5 release
en.lead: A candidate can be promoted only after evaluation, Canary, and limited real use; if it regresses, it must roll back with an explanation.
en.outcome: A candidate passes evaluation, Canary, and limited real use to promote; regressions roll back with a reason.
steps: Implement Shadow → Canary → Promote → Rollback with permission intersection.
Add versioning, signing, and runtime selection to skills.
Build skill UI showing candidates, permissions, evaluation, and current selection.
Complete at least one full promotion case and rehearse rollback.
Record rollback reason, impact scope, and user-facing explanation.
Publish the Stage 5 safety and evaluation report with no permission expansion or security regression.
en.gate: All Stage 5 exits hold; one skill has control evaluation, promotion, and rollback records; no security regression; users understand why the new method is used.
